summary: Dedicated customer request: export per-route inference cost breakdown (CSV/API) for showback
description:
Issue summary:
Rivermark Analytics (Dedicated) is requesting an exportable per-route cost breakdown (preferably CSV download from Console and/or an API endpoint) to support internal showback/chargeback and monthly reporting.

Impact:
- Customer cannot easily operationalize Redwood Console cost breakdown data outside of the UI.
- Current workflow requires screenshots/manual transcription, which is error-prone and blocks finance reporting.

Customer request (as stated):
- “We need per-route cost breakdown exported monthly for our internal cost allocation. Ideally: CSV by route + model + time window, including compute vs cache savings.”

Current state (what we have today):
- Console shows cost/usage views, but per-route breakdown export is not available as a first-class feature.
- The Standard Cost Model (SCM) work is in progress to standardize breakdown semantics for Console + Optimize. SCM outputs are explicitly not the source of truth for invoicing at this time.

What Support needs:
- Confirm feasibility/timeline for a supported export path.
- Determine whether the export should be driven from Console (UI export) vs a customer-facing endpoint vs a support-delivered report.
- Ensure any export aligns with audit logging / RBAC requirements (cost breakdown treated as customer-sensitive).

Notes:
- Customer specifically asked for “per-route” granularity. We should clarify whether they mean:
  (a) API route/endpoint in their app (Redwood route tags),
  (b) Redwood API paths, or
  (c) their own internal routing key.
- If we do add export: need to enforce cardinality controls (route names can be high-cardinality) and provide aggregation windows.

Requested next steps:
1) Product/Eng triage: confirm if this becomes part of SCM/Console roadmap vs separate feature.
2) Provide customer with interim workaround guidance (what’s possible today) and set expectations on timeline/commitments.

Attachments/links provided by customer:
- None (request came via email to Support alias; no logs).

Internal references:
- Similar theme in SUP-8821 (customer asked for explanation output when estimates drift); this request is export/aggregation rather than drift investigation.

Owner:
- Support: Felix Schneider
- Console Eng consult: Chloe Martin / Dylan Brooks
- PM consult: Marissa Cole (Console) / Aditya Rao (Optimize)
- Platform consult: Priya Natarajan (Cost Model service ownership)
comments:
2025-02-07 10:14 PT — Felix Schneider (Support)
Thanks for the request. To make sure we scope this correctly: when you say “per-route,” are you referring to Redwood Console “routes” (your configured routing keys / endpoints), or Redwood API paths, or a tag you send with requests? Also, what time window do you need (daily/monthly) and do you need a breakdown by model + region?

In parallel, we’re checking internally on export options; today Console supports viewing the breakdown but we don’t yet have a supported export endpoint/CSV for that per-route view.

2025-02-07 12:02 PT — Customer (Rivermark Analytics)
Per-route = the routes we define in Redwood for different application features. Monthly export is the main need, but weekly would also help. Breakdown by model + route is required; region less important (we’re mostly us-east). We’d like compute vs cache/batching savings separated if possible.

2025-02-08 09:31 PT — Chloe Martin (Console Backend)
Internal note: Console backend currently has the per-route breakdown shape in UI responses, but we don’t have:
- a CSV export pipeline,
- a stable public contract for the breakdown fields,
- nor an API intended for customer automation.

SCM work will standardize the breakdown semantics and add an “explain” endpoint for attribution factors (see redwood/pr-18677), but the customer-facing exposure/export is not committed yet. If we add export, we’ll need RBAC + audit events for reads (security has flagged cost breakdown as customer-sensitive).

2025-02-10 11:18 PT — Felix Schneider (Support)
Looping in Marissa (Console PM) + Priya (Platform) for roadmap guidance. Customer’s specific ask: monthly CSV export per route + model, with compute vs cache/batching components, for Dedicated showback. Is this something we can commit to as part of SCM rollout, or should we log as a separate feature request with a tentative quarter?

Also: if we offer an interim approach, what’s the least-wrong recommendation (e.g., aggregated usage export + manual mapping) without implying SCM is billable truth?

2025-02-12 15:40 PT — Marissa Cole (PM, Console)
We should treat this as a feature request tied to SCM maturity but not guaranteed in the initial SCM release. SCM helps us define consistent fields; export is an additional product surface (UI + permissions + audit + stability guarantees).

Proposal:
- Log as a tracked feature request: “Cost breakdown export (CSV) by route/model/time window.”
- Offer interim: we can share aggregated usage exports (what Console already supports) and we can schedule a short enablement call to walk through how the breakdown is computed in Console.
- No commitments on timeline yet; we can revisit once SCM endpoints stabilize and we have audit logging coverage.

2025-02-13 09:05 PT — Felix Schneider (Support)
Update for customer: We can’t commit to a CSV/API export for per-route breakdown immediately, but we’ve logged this as a product feature request tied to our ongoing cost-model standardization work. In the near term, the supported path is the existing usage exports plus the Console breakdown view.

If helpful, we can do a 30-minute call to:
1) confirm the exact route/model dimensions you need, and
2) suggest a workable monthly reporting approach with today’s exports while we evaluate adding first-class breakdown export.

Please confirm your preferred reporting format (CSV columns) and whether route names contain any customer/PII so we can evaluate safe handling.

2025-02-18 14:27 PT — Customer (Rivermark Analytics)
Understood. CSV columns we want: month, route, model, total_cost_estimate, compute_cost, cache_savings (if that’s how you represent it), tokens_in/out. Route names don’t contain PII.

Please keep us posted on timeline; this is a blocker for our internal finance process.

2025-02-21 10:11 PT — Felix Schneider (Support)
Thanks—captured the desired CSV shape. Closing this ticket as a tracked feature request on our side. We’ll proactively reach back out when we have an ETA or an early-access option.

Internal follow-ups:
- Confirm SCM/Console field naming to map to the customer’s requested columns.
- Ensure any export feature includes RBAC + audit logging and avoids high-cardinality pitfalls.

If the blocker becomes urgent before we have product support: we can explore a one-time, support-generated report from existing aggregates (best-effort) — but that would not be automated/self-serve.
